label: Chapter {{number}}
empty_text: This chapter is empty. Write it yourself or start the writer agent.
full_text_hint: Paragraphs are separated by blank lines. Saving aligns them and keeps their ids.
no_versions_hint: Submitting for review, approving, or Save version creates one.
write_dialog.title: Write this chapter
write_dialog.description: The write session drafts from the accepted outline. You can pause, edit and give feedback at any point.
write_dialog.guidance_placeholder: Optional. The planner reads this before drafting the outline.
write_dialog.not_ready_title: The previous chapter is not ready
locked_banner: The writer is working — Pause to edit.
write_dialog.not_ready_canon: Chapter {{number}} is official, but its canon has not been synced yet. Writing anyway may leave this chapter inconsistent with it.
write_dialog.not_ready_status: Chapter {{number}} is not official yet. Writing anyway may leave this chapter inconsistent with it.
review.waiting: Chapter {{number}} is waiting for your review.
review.not_in_review: This tab shows review reports; approve or send back from the header.
review.no_reports_body: Ask the reviewer to read this chapter and report problems.
send_back_dialog.title: Send back for revision
send_back_dialog.description: The writer receives this feedback and the issues you tick.
send_back_dialog.feedback_placeholder: Say what to change and why.
send_back_dialog.mode_revise_hint: Keep the text and fix the listed problems.
send_back_dialog.mode_redraft_hint: Archive this text and draft again from the current outline, following your feedback. To change the plan, redo the outline first.
send_back_dialog.version_note: The current text is saved as a version first.
discuss_dialog.title: Discuss with the reviewer
discuss_dialog.description: Your comment reopens the review; unchanged text continues the same session.
discuss_dialog.placeholder: What did the reviewer get wrong or miss?
submit_confirm.title: End the open writer session?
submit_confirm.description: Submitting for review ends the writer session that is still open on this chapter. It will not resume.
delete.title: Delete {{label}}?
delete.body: The chapter is deleted for good, with its text, versions and review reports.
delete.renumber: Later chapters of this track are renumbered, and the first and last appearance of the entities that appeared here are computed again.
delete.canon_kept: This chapter is official: canon keeps its records, but the chapter references in them become null.
delete.session_open: An agent session is still open on this chapter. End that session, then delete.
delete.session_open_id: Agent session #{{id}} is still open on this chapter. End that session, then delete.
delete.session_open_action: Open the chapter to end the session
delete.is_anchor: This chapter anchors a side story, so it cannot be deleted yet:
delete.is_anchor_hint: Point each side story below at another anchor chapter, then delete this one.
pending_title: The agent wrote this. Apply it?
pending_title_superseded: The agent's text was not applied
pending_body: The highlighted paragraphs are what changes when you apply it. Nothing is stored until you decide.
pending_superseded_body: You edited the draft after the agent wrote this (the draft is now version {{draft}}, the agent read version {{expected}}), so its text is not applied. Continue to let it carry on from your draft.
pending_request_changes_hint: Your feedback goes to the agent, which rewrites the text and continues. This text is not applied.
pending_preview_note: Preview: the highlighted paragraphs are the agent's text, not part of your draft yet.
word_count_projected: Word count once the staged write applies (projection only, not stored)
write_dialog.outline_missing_hint: A write session drafts from an accepted outline. Write the outline first.
outline_dialog.title: Write the chapter outline
outline_dialog.description: The planner researches the chapter, then submits an outline and reference notes. It takes effect when you accept it.
outline_tab.empty_hint: Write the outline first; the writer drafts from it.
outline_tab.planner_working_hint: Retrieval and planning happen in the agent panel. You can watch or pause it there.
outline_tab.proposal_hint: Approve it to make it this chapter's outline, or request changes.
outline_tab.current_replaced: This is the outline in effect now; approving replaces it.
send_back_dialog.outline_missing_hint: A redraft drafts from an accepted outline. Write the outline first, then send back again.
